name: SIMPLE Collaboration
notes: No formation date, roster or official website was found; the group's old web address (a Lisbon page) is dead.

summary.plain: The group behind the SIMPLE droplet dark matter search at the LSBB in France, formed mainly of researchers from Lisbon and Paris with staff of the underground laboratory.
summary.technical: Authors of the SIMPLE Phase II papers (arXiv:1404.4309) are from Universidade Nova de Lisboa, Centro de Física Nuclear (Lisbon), Instituto Tecnológico e Nuclear (Sacavém), the Laboratoire Souterrain à Bas Bruit and others; the paper's author line reads 'The SIMPLE collaboration'.
